neighbours.label: the accented 'í' as its own token inside a Spanish surname or given name (An|í|bal, Ort|í|z, Mart|í|nez, Dom|í|nguez)
fire: The defender Pablo Rodríguez joined the team from Montevideo.
Judge Elena Ramírez read the verdict on Thursday.

Senator Jorge Domínguez voted against the bill.

notes: Probes: Aníbal/Medellín 0.93, Ortíz 1.00, Domínguez 0.89, Martínez 0.72, Benítez 0.69, Ríos/Efraín 0.66; 'ín' and 'ía' as merged tokens (Joaquín, Sofía) 0.04-0.08, unaccented Dominguez 0.18, García/Málaga 0.05. Also fires on katakana ピ (コンピューティング 0.74) and on 'ari' in 'Shari' 0.85, so the shared thing may be a stressed /i/ syllable in the middle of a name or loanword; only the Spanish case is tested.
